name: com.director.bridge
description: Imports Director exchange packages into a Unity scene with stable director_id components, physical cameras, lights, PBR material fallback, Humanoid/Generic avatars for skinned characters, and a Unity Timeline with baked Director animation. Exports director-dcc-return-v1 packages back to Director. Source-only connector; scene payloads travel as GLB plus manifest JSON, never as Unity YAML.
